owner_approval.quoted_answers: The owner answered the M2 decision list in this session. Quoted answers: "2. yes 3. yes 4. yes", "yes for all others", and for TOKEN "1. yes 2. yes 3. yes 4. exclude it 5. keep 6. yes".
scroll_approved_amendments: Pair trials one to one within each seed.
Split the p > 0 write path by outcome.
Use the installed Google Chrome, with its version recorded.

amendments.A1: Trial-level pairing within seed (protocol section 4; DEC-008 A1).
amendments.A2: Write path at p > 0 split into success and failure strata, both primary; mixed estimand secondary (protocol section 4; EXP-003 section 4; DEC-008 A2).
amendments.A3: Read-path trials excluded when the measured hover-to-click lead deviates from h by more than 25 ms or no hover was recorded (protocol section 7; DEC-008 A3, exclusion option).
amendments.A4: Event Timing duration descriptive only (protocol section 3.2; DEC-008 A4).
amendments.A5: Installed Google Chrome through channel chrome, version recorded per run (protocol section 2; DEC-005 option b).
amendments.A6: 20 seeds (1..20) for EXP-002 and EXP-003 (protocol section 5; DEC-008 A5).

common_decisions.C1: Data: synthetic data only. SCROLL uses a locally served mock interface with a seeded schedule; no external data.
common_decisions.C2: PDFs: built with pandoc and Typst (-V mainfont="Libertinus Serif"); there is no LaTeX on the machine.
common_decisions.C3: Authorship: "Mohamed Bechir Kefi", no affiliation. The AI is disclosed as a research and development assistant, not as an author.
common_decisions.C4: Disclosure: exploratory values of the primary contrasts were seen before the freeze; see c4_disclosure.

c4_disclosure.summary: Before the freeze, exploratory run EXP-001-20261124T161058Z (seeds 1001 to 1005, disjoint from confirmatory seeds 1 to 20; K = 5; noisy machine) produced values of the contrasts that later became primary. They informed amendments A1, A2, A3 and A6. No amendment value was tuned on them: the 25 ms tolerance and the 20 seeds were stated in DEC-008 before approval.
